statements.formal_part: Lean proves the Gibbs inequality and equality for the finite family; the paper statement allows any real exponent and N=1, while the linked Lean file treats N>0 and the existence result is stated for a positive exponent.

statements.title: Existence and uniqueness of the MaxEnt exponent on finite support
statements.formal_part: Lean certifies existence, uniqueness and maximality for 0<lambda<log(N!)/N, with a positive exponent. The paper also states the zero- and negative-exponent regimes and the endpoints; those parts lie outside these Lean theorems.

statements.formal_part: Lean checks the algebraic identity L²/3−(L/2)²=L²/12; the transformation of the continuous density to a uniform one and the computation of the two moments remain proved in the text.

statements.title: Entropy of the finite family and its asymptotic regimes
statements.formal_part: Lean proves the finite upper bound and its equality case for distributions on a finite alphabet; the three asymptotic regimes of the theorem are not formalized there.
